question.en: How does the Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) improve upon the Human Poverty Index (HPI)?
question.hi: How does the Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) improve upon the Human Poverty Index (HPI)?

modelAnswer.en: MPI provides a more granular view by using household-level data and a wider range of indicators, addressing the limitations of the aggregate-level HPI.
